name: Carmel Coastal Retreat
address: 3 Victoria Bay Rd, Victoria Bay, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Coastal retreat offering fresh café fare and coffee with sweeping ocean views in Victoria Bay.
description_long:
Perched above Victoria Bay's famous surf break, Carmel Coastal Retreat serves up wholesome café meals alongside some of the Garden Route's most spectacular ocean views. The menu focuses on fresh, locally-sourced ingredients with everything from hearty breakfasts to light lunches and proper coffee.

The relaxed atmosphere makes it ideal for a post-beach bite or a leisurely breakfast before exploring the Garden Route. Whether you're staying at the guesthouse or just passing through, the deck seating offers front-row seats to dolphin sightings and stunning coastal panoramas. The café complements the retreat's wedding and event venue facilities, but remains accessible to all visitors seeking good food in a beautiful setting.

Victoria Bay itself is a gem – a sheltered cove between Wilderness and George that's beloved by surfers and families alike. Carmel captures that laid-back coastal vibe while delivering quality café fare that keeps both locals and travellers coming back.
